newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Densan aims for NYSE listing by 2000/01.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Densan aims for NYSE listing by 2000/01.

text.p: Nippon Densan Corp said on Friday it aims to list its shares on the New York Stock Exchange by as early as the 2000/01 business year.
"Listing our shares would give us international recognition and an opportunity to procure a large amount of funds," a company spokesman said.
The Kyoto-based manufacturer of small-scale spindle motors for hard disk drives has been operating in the United States since the mid-1970s, the spokesman said.
The company also hopes to register its U.S. subsidiary Nidec America Co on NASDAQ in the future, he said.
